name: What is the difference between property restoration and property remodeling?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between property restoration and property remodeling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Property restoration focuses on returning a damaged structure to its pre-loss, safe condition after events like severe storms, leaks, or foreclosure neglect. Property remodeling, by contrast, alters the layout, aesthetics, or function of an existing, undamaged space. However, restoration projects often turn into remodeling opportunities. For example, when storm damage requires tearing out ruined drywall, insulation, or subfloors, homeowners often choose to upgrade their finishes, such as replacing basic drywall with custom molding or installing new tile and marble instead of standard sheet vinyl. Combining restoration repairs with planned remodeling updates can save time and labor costs by addressing structural fixes and aesthetic improvements under a single project scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: Restoration repairs damage from storms, neglect, or moisture to make a home sound again, while remodeling upgrades design and layout. Damaged areas can often be remodeled during restoration.
